headline: Revenue growth accelerates, profitability improves
summary_short: Net revenue rose 7.5% y/y to $3,519M, with U.S. revenue up 8.7% and international down 1.3%; operating income swung to $104M from $17M a year ago, though GAAP net loss was $1M versus $15M net income last year after a $59M loss on debt extinguishment.
summary_long: Net revenue grew 7.5% y/y to $3,519M, led by 8.7% U.S. growth (Perigold +35%, specialty retail +20%) against a 1.3% international decline. Gross margin held roughly flat at 30.0%. Operating income rose to $104M from $17M as advertising and G&A expense grew slower than revenue, plus lower restructuring charges. GAAP net loss was $1M (vs $15M net income) after a $59M loss on debt extinguishment from repurchasing $145M of 2028 Notes; diluted loss per share was $0.01 versus $0.11 EPS. Adjusted EBITDA rose to $242M and free cash flow hit $301M, the strongest since 2020. Cash and short-term investments totaled $1.1 billion; long-term debt fell to $2,836M. No forward guidance was issued.

drivers.explanation: Revenue growth accelerated on order and customer momentum while cost discipline let operating income and free cash flow swing sharply higher, though a debt-extinguishment loss kept GAAP net income negative.
Growth was fueled by order momentum (orders delivered +6%) and outperformance in specialty retail brands (+20%) and Perigold (+35%); U.S. revenue grew 8.7% while international revenue fell 1.3%.
Gross profit tracked revenue growth almost exactly; gross margin was roughly flat at 30.0% versus 30.1% a year ago.

Total operating expenses fell to $950M from $967M as restructuring charges dropped to zero (from $9M) and SG&A declined, while revenue grew 7.5% — expense growth undershooting revenue growth drove the swing.

A $59M loss on debt extinguishment from repurchasing $145M of 2028 Notes, plus higher interest expense, offset the operating-income improvement, pushing GAAP net income to a $1M loss from $15M a year ago.
EPS followed net income lower to a $0.01 loss from $0.11, with weighted diluted shares up slightly (132M vs 129M).
Cash fell as $701M was used to settle long-term debt and $245M to extinguish notes, partly offset by $395M of new debt issuance and $360M of operating cash flow.
Debt declined after settling and repurchasing 2028 and other notes during the quarter, partially offset by $395M of new debt issuance.
